selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a chain and not a similar-looking generated artifact (e.g., twisted rope or abstract metal sculpture).
To verify the topological correctness of the interlocking rings, ensuring they are truly linked and not just touching or fused.
To assess overall image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture anomalies in the metal and background.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the topology of the links. In AI-generated chains, links often fail to actually pass through each other, merely touching or fusing. Verify if the 'holes' in the rings align correctly with the passing links. Also, check if the specular highlights follow a consistent light source direction across the curved surfaces of the links.
